The cipher index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 321 account operation therefore ties up 38 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
